
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xu214/p/23532149" title="发布于 2026-11-03 10:29">
    
        <img src="/images/aigc-marker.svg" class="text-front-icon" title="本文内容由AI生成" alt="AIGC标识">

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">从中间件的副本确认机制到 fsync：一条数据到底什么时候才算真正安全？</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-4" data-slate-node="text">在研究 Kafka、Elasticsearch 和 MySQL 的可靠性机制时，有一个问题很容易被忽略：</span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-5" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-6" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold">一条数据写入成功，到底意味着什么？</strong></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-7" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-8" data-slate-node="text">比如，Kafka 返回了发送成功，ES 返回了写入成功，MySQL 的事务也提交成功了。这些系统都告诉我们操作已经完成，但它们对数据可靠性的保证并不完全相同。</span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-9" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-10" data-slate-node="text">有的系统只需要确认 Leader 收到了数据，有的需要等待多个副本完成写入，还有的会进一步等待日志刷入磁盘。</span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-11" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-12" data-slate-node="text">如果继续往下研究，还会遇到 MySQL 的 redo log、undo log、WAL、STEAL，以及操作系统的 write、fsync。</span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-13" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-14" data-slate-node="text">这些机制看起来分散在不同的系统和层次中，实际上都在解决一个问题：<span id="w-e-text-15" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold">数据在什么情况下能够被保留下来，发生故障后又能否恢复？</strong></span></span></span></p>
<h2 id="w-e-element-16" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-17" data-slate-node="text">一、先看副本确认：系统究竟在等待什么？</span></h2>
<p id="w-e-element-18" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-19" data-slate-node="text">先从最容易接触到的配置说起。</span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-20" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-21" data-slate-node="text">Kafka、Elasticsearch 和 MySQL 都提供了不同程度的写入确认机制，但它们等待的对象并不一样。</span></p>
<div id="w-e-element-22" class="table-container" data-slate-node="element">
<table style="width: auto"><colgroup><col width="auto"><col width="auto"><col width="auto"></colgroup>
<tbody>

<td id="w-e-element-33" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-34" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">acks=0</span></code></span></span></td>
<td id="w-e-element-35" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-36" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">不等待 Broker 确认</span></span></span></td>

<td id="w-e-element-38" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-39" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">Kafka</span></span></span></td>
<td id="w-e-element-40" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-41" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">acks=1</span></code></span></span></td>
<td id="w-e-element-42" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-43" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">Leader 确认写入</span></span></span></td>
</tr>

<td id="w-e-element-45" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-46" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">Kafka</span></span></span></td>
<td id="w-e-element-47" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-48" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">acks=all</span></code></span></span></td>
<td id="w-e-element-49" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-50" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">当前 ISR 中的副本全部确认</span></span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr id="w-e-element-51" data-slate-node="element">
<td id="w-e-element-52" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-53" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">Elasticsearch</span></span></span></td>
<td id="w-e-element-54" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-55" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">wait_for_active_shards=1</span></code></span></span></td>
<td id="w-e-element-56" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-57" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">写入前至少有一个活跃分片副本</span></span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr id="w-e-element-58" data-slate-node="element">
<td id="w-e-element-59" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-60" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">Elasticsearch</span></span></span></td>
<td id="w-e-element-61" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-62" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">wait_for_active_shards=n</span></code></span></span></td>
<td id="w-e-element-63" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-64" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">写入前要求指定数量的活跃分片副本</span></span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr id="w-e-element-65" data-slate-node="element">
<td id="w-e-element-66" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-67" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">Elasticsearch</span></span></span></td>
<td id="w-e-element-68" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-69" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">wait_for_active_shards=all</span></code></span></span></td>
<td id="w-e-element-70" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-71" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">写入前要求所有分配的副本活跃</span></span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr id="w-e-element-72" data-slate-node="element">
<td id="w-e-element-73" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-74" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">MySQL</span></span></span></td>
<td id="w-e-element-75" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-76" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">异步复制</span></span></span></td>
<td id="w-e-element-77" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-78" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">主库提交不等待从库</span></span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr id="w-e-element-79" data-slate-node="element">
<td id="w-e-element-80" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-81" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">MySQL</span></span></span></td>
<td id="w-e-element-82" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-83" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">半同步复制</span></span></span></td>
<td id="w-e-element-84" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-85" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">等待至少一个从库确认接收日志</span></span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr id="w-e-element-86" data-slate-node="element">

<td id="w-e-element-89" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-90" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">Group Replication</span></span></span></td>
<td id="w-e-element-91" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-92" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">通过组通信和事务认证等机制协调事务</span></span></span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<p id="w-e-element-93" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-94" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">这里有几个容易混淆的地方。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-95" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-96" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">1. Kafka 的 acks=all 并不意味着等待所有配置的副本。</span></strong></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-97" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-98" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">它等待的是当前 ISR（In-Sync Replicas）中的副本。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-99" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-100" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">如果某个 Follower 落后太多，就可能被移出 ISR。此时即使配置了 <span id="w-e-text-101" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">acks=all</span></code><span id="w-e-text-102" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">，也不会等待这个已经被移出的副本。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-103" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-104" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">所以生产环境通常还需要配合 <span id="w-e-text-105" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">min.insync.replicas</span></code><span id="w-e-text-106" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 使用。当 ISR 数量低于这个阈值时，Broker 会拒绝写入，避免 ISR 只剩 Leader 时，<span id="w-e-text-107" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">acks=all</span></code><span id="w-e-text-108" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 实际上退化成只等待 Leader。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-109" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-110" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">2. Elasticsearch 的 wait_for_active_shards 也容易被误解。</span></strong></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-111" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-112" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">它控制的是写入前的活跃分片门槛，不是“等待所有副本写完”的开关。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-113" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-114" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">ES 写入时，主分片会将写入操作同步到副本分片，默认需要等待所有 in-sync copies 副本完成写入后，才向客户端返回成功。而 wait_for_active_shards控制的是写入开始前，至少需要有多少个分片副本处于活跃状态。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-115" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-116" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">3. MySQL 半同步复制等待的也不是从库执行事务完成。</span></strong></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-117" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-118" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">MySQL 半同步确认的是事务事件已经写入从库 relay log 并刷盘，不要求从库已经执行完事务。主库提交成功时，从库上的查询仍可能读到旧值。半同步等待超时后还会退回异步复制，可靠性也会随运行状态变化。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-119" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-120" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">这三套系统的确认机制虽然不同，但有一个共同点：</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-121" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-122" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">它们首先解决的是副本之间的协调问题。接下来要看，这些确认发生时，数据已经写到了哪里。</span></span></span></p>
<h2 id="w-e-element-123" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-124" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">二、数据被副本确认之后，真的已经落盘了吗？</span></span></span></h2>
<p id="w-e-element-125" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-126" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">继续往下看，差异就比较明显了。</span></span></span></p>
<h3 id="w-e-element-127" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-128" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">1. Kafka：副本确认不等于磁盘刷盘</span></span></span></h3>
<p id="w-e-element-129" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-130" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">Kafka 的消息采用日志追加的方式写入磁盘文件。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-131" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-132" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">Broker 接收到消息后，会将数据写入对应的日志文件。通常情况下，数据先进入操作系统的 Page Cache，后续再由操作系统异步回写到磁盘。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-133" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-134" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">当配置 <span id="w-e-text-135" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">acks=all</span></code><span id="w-e-text-136" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 时，Leader 需要等待当前 ISR 中的所有副本完成相应的日志追加操作，然后才能向生产者返回成功。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-137" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-138" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">这里需要注意：</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-139" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-140" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">Kafka 的 acks=all 并不要求每个副本都执行 fsync。</span></strong></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-141" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-142" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">也就是说，Leader 和 Follower 都可能已经完成写入，但数据实际上还停留在各自操作系统的 Page Cache 中。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-143" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-144" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">如果此时发生操作系统崩溃或突然断电，尚未刷盘的数据仍然可能丢失。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-145" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-146" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">因此，Kafka 的多副本确认主要解决的是副本层面的可靠性，并不等价于每个副本都完成了物理持久化。</span></span></span></p>
<h3 id="w-e-element-147" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-148" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">2. Elasticsearch：默认会等待 translog 刷盘</span></span></span></h3>
<p id="w-e-element-149" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-150" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">Elasticsearch 的情况有所不同。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-151" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-152" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">ES 写入数据时，会先将数据写入 Lucene 的 Index Buffer，之后将写入操作追加到 translog（有先后顺序的）。Index Buffer 中的数据经过 refresh 后生成 Lucene Segment，供查询使用；translog 则负责故障恢复，避免数据在完成 Lucene commit （flush）之前丢失。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-153" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-154" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">默认配置下：</span></span></span></p>
<pre data-slate-node="element"><code id="w-e-element-156" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-157" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">index.translog.durability=reques</span></span></span></code></pre>
<p id="w-e-element-158" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-159" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">在 request 模式下，每次写入请求完成前，ES 都会对 translog 执行 <span id="w-e-text-160" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">fsync</span></code><span id="w-e-text-161" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">，确保日志持久化后再向客户端返回成功。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-162" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-163" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">如果改成：</span></span></span></p>
<pre data-slate-node="element"><code id="w-e-element-165" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-166" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">index.translog.durability=async</span></span></span></code></pre>
<p id="w-e-element-167" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-168" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">则由后台线程按照 <span id="w-e-text-169" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">index.translog.sync_interval</span></code><span id="w-e-text-170" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 定期刷盘，默认间隔为 5 秒。这样可以减少同步刷盘的开销，但发生故障时，最近尚未刷盘的数据可能丢失。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-171" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-172" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">上述讲的是translog的持久化，另外索引数据的两个操作如下：</span></span></span></p>
<div id="w-e-element-173" data-slate-node="element"><span data-w-e-reserve="true">•<span id="w-e-text-174" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">refresh：生成新的 Lucene Segment，使数据可以被搜索，此时数据本身在page cache里面。</span></span></span></span></div>
<div id="w-e-element-175" data-slate-node="element"><span data-w-e-reserve="true">•<span id="w-e-text-176" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">flush：执行 Lucene commit，持久化索引数据到磁盘，并清理不再需要的 translog 记录。</span></span></span></span></div>
<h3 id="w-e-element-177" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-178" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">3. MySQL：提交成功是否持久化，取决于刷盘配置</span></span></span></h3>
<p id="w-e-element-179" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-180" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">MySQL InnoDB 的事务提交主要涉及 redo log 和 binlog。（redo log 是 InnoDB 引擎私有的“崩溃恢复”日志，而 binlog 是 MySQL Server 层公有的“归档与复制”日志。）</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-181" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-182" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">这里有两个非常重要的参数：</span></span></span></p>
<pre data-slate-node="element"><code id="w-e-element-184" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-185" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit
sync_binlog</span></span></span></code></pre>
<p id="w-e-element-186" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-187" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">第一个控制 InnoDB redo log 的刷盘策略，第二个控制 binlog 的刷盘策略。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-188" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-189" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit</span></code><span id="w-e-text-190" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 有三个常见配置：</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<div id="w-e-element-191" class="table-container" data-slate-node="element">
<table style="width: auto"><colgroup><col width="auto"><col width="auto"><col width="auto"></colgroup>
<tbody>
<tr id="w-e-element-192" data-slate-node="element"><th id="w-e-element-193" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-194" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">配置</span></span></span></th><th id="w-e-element-195" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-196" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">行为</span></span></span></th><th id="w-e-element-197" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-198" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">故障风险</span></span></span></th></tr>
<tr id="w-e-element-199" data-slate-node="element">
<td id="w-e-element-200" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-201" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">0</span></span></span></td>

<td id="w-e-element-211" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-212" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">已提交事务具备较强的持久性保证</span></span></span></td>

<tr id="w-e-element-213" data-slate-node="element">
<td id="w-e-element-214" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-215" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">2</span></span></span></td>
<td id="w-e-element-216" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-217" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">每次提交写入 OS Page Cache，定期 fsync</span></span></span></td>
<td id="w-e-element-218" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-219" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">MySQL 进程崩溃通常不丢，但 OS 崩溃可能丢失最近事务</span></span></span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<p id="w-e-element-220" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-221" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">这里的定期刷盘通常约为 1 秒，但并不是严格的时间上限。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-222" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-223" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">sync_binlog</span></code><span id="w-e-text-224" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 则控制 binlog：</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<div id="w-e-element-225" class="table-container" data-slate-node="element">
<table style="width: auto"><colgroup><col width="auto"><col width="auto"></colgroup>
<tbody>
<tr id="w-e-element-226" data-slate-node="element"><th id="w-e-element-227" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-228" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">配置</span></span></span></th><th id="w-e-element-229" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-230" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">行为</span></span></span></th></tr>
<tr id="w-e-element-231" data-slate-node="element">
<td id="w-e-element-232" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-233" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">0</span></span></span></td>
<td id="w-e-element-234" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-235" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">由操作系统决定何时刷盘</span></span></span></td>

<td id="w-e-element-239" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-240" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">每次事务提交时同步 binlog</span></span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr id="w-e-element-241" data-slate-node="element">
<td id="w-e-element-242" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-243" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">N</span></span></span></td>
<td id="w-e-element-244" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-245" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">累积 N 个事务后同步一次</span></span></span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<p id="w-e-element-246" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-247" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">生产环境中经常提到的双 1 配置，就是：</span></span></span></p>
<pre data-slate-node="element"><code id="w-e-element-249" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-250" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit=1
sync_binlog=1</span></span></span></code></pre>
<p id="w-e-element-251" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-252" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">两个参数分别保证 InnoDB redo log 和 binlog 的持久性。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-253" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-254" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">为什么需要同时关注这两个日志？</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-255" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-256" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">因为它们承担的职责不同。redo log 主要服务于 InnoDB 的崩溃恢复，binlog 则承担逻辑日志、复制和时间点恢复等职责。</span></span></span></p>
<h2 id="w-e-element-257" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-258" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">三、深入 InnoDB：为什么 redo log 不只在事务提交时刷盘？</span></span></span></h2>
<p id="w-e-element-259" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-260" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">前面提到，<span id="w-e-text-261" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit=1</span></code><span id="w-e-text-262" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 表示每次事务提交时同步刷 redo log。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-263" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-264" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">但如果进一步研究 InnoDB 的刷盘机制，会发现一个问题：</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-265" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-266" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">redo log 并不是只有事务提交时才会刷盘。</span></strong></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-267" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-268" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">要理解这一点，需要先认识两个概念：WAL 和 STEAL。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-269" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-270" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">WAL（Write-Ahead Logging）是预写日志机制，核心要求是：</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-271" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-272" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">在数据页写入磁盘之前，必须先保证能够恢复该数据页修改的日志已经持久化。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-273" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-274" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">而 STEAL 是数据库 Buffer Pool 管理中的一种策略。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-275" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-276" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">它允许数据库将包含未提交事务修改的脏页提前写入磁盘，以便回收内存空间。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-277" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-278" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">这两个机制放在一起，就会产生一个很有意思的问题。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-279" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-280" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">假设有一个事务：</span></span></span></p>
<pre data-slate-node="element"><code id="w-e-element-282" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-283" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">BEGIN;

UPDATE account
SET balance = balance - 100
WHERE id = 1;

-- 尚未提交</span></span></span></code></pre>
<p id="w-e-element-284" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-285" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">事务执行后，InnoDB 修改了 Buffer Pool 中的数据页，同时产生对应的 redo log 和 undo log。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-286" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-287" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">此时事务还没有提交，但如果 Buffer Pool 空间不足，InnoDB 可能需要将这个脏页提前刷入磁盘。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-288" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-289" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">这就是 STEAL。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-290" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-291" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">问题来了：</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-292" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-293" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">如果数据页已经写入磁盘，而对应的 redo log 还没有持久化，那么一旦发生崩溃，数据库可能只留下了数据修改，却无法通过日志恢复这些修改。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-294" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-295" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">这显然是不允许的。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-296" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-297" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">因此，InnoDB 必须遵循 WAL 规则：</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-298" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-299" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">任何脏页刷盘之前，都必须确保对应的 redo log 已经持久化。</span></strong></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-300" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-301" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">这与事务是否提交没有直接关系。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-302" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-303" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">所以，InnoDB 的 redo log 至少存在两类刷盘驱动：</span></span></span></p>
<div id="w-e-element-304" class="table-container" data-slate-node="element">
<table style="width: auto"><colgroup><col width="auto"><col width="auto"><col width="auto"></colgroup>
<tbody>
<tr id="w-e-element-305" data-slate-node="element"><th id="w-e-element-306" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-307" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">场景</span></span></span></th><th id="w-e-element-308" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-309" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">触发原因</span></span></span></th><th id="w-e-element-310" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-311" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">目的</span></span></span></th></tr>
<tr id="w-e-element-312" data-slate-node="element">
<td id="w-e-element-313" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-314" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">事务提交</span></span></span></td>
<td id="w-e-element-315" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-316" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">受 <span id="w-e-text-317" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit</span></code><span id="w-e-text-318" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 控制</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></td>
<td id="w-e-element-319" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-320" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">保证已提交事务的持久性</span></span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr id="w-e-element-321" data-slate-node="element">
<td id="w-e-element-322" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-323" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">脏页刷盘</span></span></span></td>
<td id="w-e-element-324" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-325" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">WAL 强制要求</span></span></span></td>
<td id="w-e-element-326" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-327" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">保证磁盘上的数据页能够通过日志恢复</span></span></span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<p id="w-e-element-328" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-329" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">两者解决的是不同的问题。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-330" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-331" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">前者关注事务提交后的持久性，后者关注数据页写入磁盘时的一致性和可恢复性。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-332" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-333" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">这也是为什么不能简单地把 <span id="w-e-text-334" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit=1</span></code><span id="w-e-text-335" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 理解成 redo log 只在事务提交时刷盘。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h2 id="w-e-element-336" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-337" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">四、undo log 为什么也不会丢？</span></span></span></h2>
<p id="w-e-element-338" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-339" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">理解了 redo log 的刷盘规则，再看 undo log 就容易多了。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-340" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-341" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">undo log 主要用于事务回滚和 MVCC。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-342" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-343" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">例如：</span></span></span></p>
<pre data-slate-node="element"><code id="w-e-element-345" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-346" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">UPDATE account
SET balance = balance - 100
WHERE id = 1;</span></span></span></code></pre>
<p id="w-e-element-347" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-348" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">假设修改之前余额是 1000，修改之后变成 900。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-349" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-350" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">为了支持事务回滚，InnoDB 需要保留修改前的数据，也就是旧值 1000。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-351" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-352" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">这些信息会被记录到 undo log 中。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-353" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-354" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">但 undo log 并不是一份独立于 InnoDB 存储体系的特殊日志文件，它本身存储在 InnoDB 的 undo tablespace 或相关存储结构中，其页面也由 Buffer Pool 管理。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-355" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-356" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">undo 页的修改同样会产生 redo log。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-357" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-358" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">这就形成了一个关系：</span></span></span></p>
<div id="w-e-element-359" data-slate-node="element"><span data-w-e-reserve="true">•<span id="w-e-text-360" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">修改数据页，会产生 redo log。</span></span></span></span></div>
<div id="w-e-element-361" data-slate-node="element"><span data-w-e-reserve="true">•<span id="w-e-text-362" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">修改 undo 页，也会产生 redo log。</span></span></span></span></div>
<div id="w-e-element-363" data-slate-node="element"><span data-w-e-reserve="true">•<span id="w-e-text-364" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">数据页和 undo 页都可能成为脏页。</span></span></span></span></div>
<div id="w-e-element-365" data-slate-node="element"><span data-w-e-reserve="true">•<span id="w-e-text-366" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">脏页刷盘前，都必须满足 WAL 要求。</span></span></span></span></div>
<p id="w-e-element-367" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-368" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">我们再沿着前面的事务推演一次。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-369" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-370" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">假设事务 T 将余额从 1000 修改为 900，但还没有提交。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-371" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-372" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">此时：</span></span></span></p>
<div id="w-e-element-373" data-slate-node="element"><span data-w-e-reserve="true">1.<span id="w-e-text-374" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">数据页中记录了新值 900。</span></span></span></span></div>
<div id="w-e-element-375" data-slate-node="element"><span data-w-e-reserve="true">2.<span id="w-e-text-376" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">undo log 中保存了旧值 1000。</span></span></span></span></div>
<div id="w-e-element-377" data-slate-node="element"><span data-w-e-reserve="true">3.<span id="w-e-text-378" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">数据页和 undo 页都可能处于脏页状态。</span></span></span></span></div>
<div id="w-e-element-379" data-slate-node="element"><span data-w-e-reserve="true">4.<span id="w-e-text-380" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">对应的页面修改都产生了 redo log。</span></span></span></span></div>
<p id="w-e-element-381" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-382" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">如果此时 InnoDB 决定将数据页刷入磁盘，那么在数据页写入之前，对应的 redo log 必须已经持久化。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-383" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-384" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">由于 undo 页的修改也有对应的 redo log，因此这些日志同样受到 WAL 的保护。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-385" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-386" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">假设此时发生崩溃。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-387" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-388" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">InnoDB 启动恢复时，会先根据 redo log 重做相应的页面修改。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-389" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-390" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">这样，即使之前的事务没有提交，数据页和 undo 页也能够恢复到崩溃前相应的状态。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-391" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-392" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">随后，InnoDB 根据事务状态识别出 T 是未提交事务，再利用 undo log 将余额从 900 回滚到 1000。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-393" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-394" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">整个过程可以概括为：</span></span></span></p>
<pre data-slate-node="element"><code id="w-e-element-396" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-397" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">事务修改数据页
       |
       v
生成 undo log
       |
       v
数据页、undo 页产生 redo log
       |
       v
WAL 保证 redo 先于脏页落盘
       |
       v
发生数据库崩溃
       |
       v
重放 redo log
       |
       v
恢复数据页和 undo 页
       |
       v
识别未提交事务
       |
       v
利用 undo log 回滚事务</span></span></span></code></pre>
<p id="w-e-element-398" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-399" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">所以，undo log 并不需要单独配置一个类似 <span id="w-e-text-400" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit</span></code><span id="w-e-text-401" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 的刷盘参数。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-402" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-403" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">它的持久化依赖 InnoDB 自身的页面管理和 redo log 机制。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-404" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-405" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">这里也能看出 WAL 和 STEAL 为什么可以同时存在：</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-406" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-407" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">STEAL 允许未提交的数据页提前落盘，WAL 则保证这些页面在发生崩溃时仍然可以被恢复和撤销。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-408" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-409" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">两者并不矛盾，反而是数据库能够兼顾内存管理效率和事务原子性的重要基础。</span></span></span></p>
<h2 id="w-e-element-410" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-411" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">五、最后一层：操作系统的 write 和 fsync 到底有什么区别？</span></span></span></h2>
<p id="w-e-element-412" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-413" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">前面无论是 Kafka、ES 还是 MySQL，都反复出现了一个词：fsync。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-414" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-415" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">它实际上是操作系统提供的文件同步接口。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-416" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-417" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">理解它，需要先区分三个位置：</span></span></span></p>
<div id="w-e-element-418" data-slate-node="element"><span data-w-e-reserve="true">1.<span id="w-e-text-419" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">应用程序自己的缓冲区。</span></span></span></span></div>
<div id="w-e-element-420" data-slate-node="element"><span data-w-e-reserve="true">2.<span id="w-e-text-421" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">操作系统的 Page Cache。</span></span></span></span></div>
<div id="w-e-element-422" data-slate-node="element"><span data-w-e-reserve="true">3.<span id="w-e-text-423" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">稳定存储设备如磁盘等。</span></span></span></span></div>
<p id="w-e-element-424" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-425" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">以 MySQL 写 redo log 为例：</span></span></span></p>
<pre data-slate-node="element"><code id="w-e-element-427" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-428" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">MySQL Log Buffer
       |
       | write
       v
OS Page Cache
       |
       | fsync
       v
磁盘稳定存储</span></span></span></code></pre>
<p id="w-e-element-429" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-430" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">write</span></code><span id="w-e-text-431" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 的作用是将应用程序提供的数据写入内核管理的文件缓存。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-432" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-433" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">调用成功，并不意味着数据已经真正写入磁盘。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-434" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-435" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">此时即使 MySQL 进程退出，数据通常仍然存在于操作系统内核中。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-436" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-437" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">但是，如果操作系统崩溃或者突然断电，Page Cache 中尚未持久化的数据就可能丢失。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-438" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-439" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">fsync</span></code><span id="w-e-text-440" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 则不同。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-441" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-442" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">它要求操作系统将指定文件的脏数据同步到存储设备，并等待同步操作完成。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-443" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-444" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">在底层存储设备正确履行持久化语义的前提下，<span id="w-e-text-445" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">fsync</span></code><span id="w-e-text-446" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 成功返回，才能认为相关数据已经达到稳定存储。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-447" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-448" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">当然，这里还有一个容易被忽略的细节：如果涉及新建文件、重命名等操作，仅对文件执行 fsync 并不一定足够，还可能需要同步父目录，以保证目录项变更也持久化。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-449" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-450" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">回到 MySQL 的三个配置：</span></span></span></p>
<div id="w-e-element-451" class="table-container" data-slate-node="element">
<table style="width: auto"><colgroup><col width="auto"><col width="auto"><col width="auto"></colgroup>
<tbody>
<tr id="w-e-element-452" data-slate-node="element"><th id="w-e-element-453" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-454" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">配置</span></span></span></th><th id="w-e-element-455" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-456" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">主要写入位置</span></span></span></th><th id="w-e-element-457" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-458" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">对应风险</span></span></span></th></tr>
<tr id="w-e-element-459" data-slate-node="element">
<td id="w-e-element-460" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-461" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit=0</span></code></span></span></td>
<td id="w-e-element-462" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-463" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">定期从 Log Buffer 写出并刷盘</span></span></span></td>
<td id="w-e-element-464" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-465" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">MySQL 进程崩溃可能丢失日志</span></span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr id="w-e-element-466" data-slate-node="element">
<td id="w-e-element-467" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-468" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit=2</span></code></span></span></td>
<td id="w-e-element-469" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-470" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">提交时写入 OS Page Cache</span></span></span></td>
<td id="w-e-element-471" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-472" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">OS 崩溃可能丢失日志</span></span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr id="w-e-element-473" data-slate-node="element">
<td id="w-e-element-474" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-475" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit=1</span></code></span></span></td>
<td id="w-e-element-476" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-477" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">提交时同步刷盘</span></span></span></td>
<td id="w-e-element-478" rowspan="1" colspan="1" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-479" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">获得更强的持久性保证</span></span></span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<p id="w-e-element-480" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-481" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">这里还需要强调：fsync 保证的是操作系统和存储设备约定的持久化语义，并不意味着能够抵御磁盘损坏、控制器故障或者所有硬件故障。</span></span></span></p>
<h2 id="w-e-element-482" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-483" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">六、回过头看三套系统，差异就比较清楚了</span></span></span></h2>
<p id="w-e-element-484" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-485" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">前面讨论了很多机制，现在再把 Kafka、ES 和 MySQL 放在一起看：</span></span></span></p>
<div id="w-e-element-486" class="table-container" data-slate-node="element">
<table style="width: auto"><colgroup><col width="auto"><col width="auto"><col width="auto"><col width="auto"></colgroup>
<tbody>

</div>
<p id="w-e-element-541" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-542" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">这里最值得注意的是：</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-543" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-544" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">Kafka 的 <span id="w-e-text-545" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">acks=all</span></code><span id="w-e-text-546" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">、ES 的默认写入确认，以及 MySQL 的事务提交成功，虽然都可以被理解为写入成功，但背后的持久化边界并不相同。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-547" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-548" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">Kafka 通过 ISR（in-sync replicas）副本机制保证可靠性</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-549" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">，在 <span id="w-e-text-550" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">acks=all</span></code><span id="w-e-text-551" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 时写入需所有同步副本确认才算提交；ES 默认在主分片和所有副本分片都完成 translog 的 fsync 后才向客户端确认；MySQL 则依靠 redo log、binlog，并通过两阶段提交协调两者，来维护事务的持久性与一致性。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-552" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-553" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">如果只看 API 返回的成功状态，很容易把这些保证混为一谈。</span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-554" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-555" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">实际上，判断一条数据是否安全，可以继续追问几个问题：</span></span></span></p>
<div id="w-e-element-556" data-slate-node="element"><span data-w-e-reserve="true">•<span id="w-e-text-557" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">有多少个副本确认了？</span></span></span></span></div>
<div id="w-e-element-558" data-slate-node="element"><span data-w-e-reserve="true">•<span id="w-e-text-559" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">副本确认时，数据是在内存还是已经落盘？</span></span></span></span></div>
<div id="w-e-element-560" data-slate-node="element"><span data-w-e-reserve="true">•<span id="w-e-text-561" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">如果数据页提前写入磁盘，相关日志是否已经持久化？</span></span></span></span></div>
<div id="w-e-element-562" data-slate-node="element" data-slate-fragment=""><span data-w-e-reserve="true">•<span id="w-e-text-563" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">如果发生崩溃，系统能否通过日志恢复数据？</span></span></span></span></div>

</div>
